statement:
∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.HB 1 (KdVPlan.invD f) (2 * KdVPlan.hn 0 f) ∧ Summable (fun k => ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖) ∧
 (∑' k, ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖) ≤ KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹) * KdVPlan.hn 0 f
proof:
intro f hf
have hnrm := (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).1
constructor
· apply yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T013 1 0 (KdVPlan.invD f) f 2 (by norm_num) hf
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk, KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.weight]; positivity
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hk
  have hk2 : 1 ≤ (k : ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs (k : ℝ)]
  have H : (1+(k : ℝ)^2) / (k : ℝ)^2 ≤ 2^2 := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hkR)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  calc
   KdVPlan.weight 1 k * ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖^2 = ((1+(k : ℝ)^2) / (k : ℝ)^2) * ‖f k‖^2 := by
    rw [(hnrm f k).2.1]
    simp only [KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_one, mul_pow, inv_pow, sq_abs]
    ring
   _ ≤ 2^2 * (KdVPlan.weight 0 k * ‖f k‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.weight] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right H (sq_nonneg ‖f k‖)
· have H := (yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_T013 _ f (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_T013).2 hf).1
  have he : (fun k => ‖KdVPlan.invD f k‖) = (fun k => ‖(Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * ‖f k‖) := by
    funext k; rw [(hnrm f k).1, norm_mul]
  simpa only [he] using H
